response.reason: The cited clause, Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 Art. 22(1), establishes the requirement that the quantity of an ingredient must be indicated when it appears in the name of the food, is emphasised, or is essential to characterise the food. The verdict turns on this exact requirement, stating that the product's name includes 'Chickpea' and 'sesame paste', and that their quantities are declared, thus satisfying the QUID requirement. The clause is directly relevant and supports the verdict.
